faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by Panjab University, Chandigarh for hiring academic professionals for the Department of Forensic Science.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by Panjab University?
faq.answer: Panjab University has advertised vacancies for the post of Guest Faculty for B.Sc. (Hons) in Forensic Science.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Guest Faculty position for the odd semester of the academic year 2026-2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for Panjab University Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted in offline mode. Candidates need to download the form and send it directly to the designated department office.

faq.question: Q5. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of the completed offline application form to the university is 05-10-2026 by 5 PM.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Forensic Science or an allied discipline with 55% marks along with NET/SLET/SET or a Ph.D. degree.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary or remuneration provided to the Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 1,500/- per lecture, with an upper monthly limit of Rs. 50,000.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification released by Panjab University for this post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for Panjab University Guest Faculty?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates for the Guest Faculty position will be based on an interview conducted by the university.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the filled application form be sent?
faq.answer: The self-attested application form and documents must be submitted to the office of the Department of Forensic Science, Panjab University, Chandigarh.
